verses.english: Numbered Discourses 10.119
12. The Ceremony of Descent
The Ceremony of Descent (1st)

verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo tadahuposathe sīsaṁnhāto navaṁ khomayugaṁ nivattho allakusamuṭṭhiṁ ādāya bhagavato avidūre ekamantaṁ ṭhito hoti.
verses.english: Now, at that time it was the sabbath. The brahmin Jānussoṇi had bathed his head and dressed in a new pair of linen robes. Holding a handful of fresh grass, he stood to one side not far from the Buddha.

verses.pali: Addasā kho bhagavā jāṇussoṇiṁ brāhmaṇaṁ tadahuposathe sīsaṁnhātaṁ navaṁ khomayugaṁ nivatthaṁ allakusamuṭṭhiṁ ādāya ekamantaṁ ṭhitaṁ.
verses.english: The Buddha saw him,
and said,

verses.pali: “kiṁ nu tvaṁ, brāhmaṇa, tadahuposathe sīsaṁnhāto navaṁ khomayugaṁ nivattho allakusamuṭṭhiṁ ādāya ekamantaṁ ṭhito?
verses.english: “Brahmin, why have you bathed your head and dressed in a new pair of linen robes? Why are you standing to one side holding a handful of fresh grass?
What’s going on today with the brahmin clan?”
“Worthy Gotama, today is the ceremony of descent for the brahmin clan.”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana, brāhmaṇa, brāhmaṇānaṁ paccorohaṇī hotī”ti?
verses.english: “But how do the brahmins observe the ceremony of descent?”

verses.pali: “Idha, bho gotama, brāhmaṇā tadahuposathe sīsaṁnhātā navaṁ khomayugaṁ nivatthā allena gomayena pathaviṁ opuñjitvā haritehi kusehi pattharitvā antarā ca velaṁ antarā ca agyāgāraṁ seyyaṁ kappenti.
verses.english: “Well, worthy Gotama, on the sabbath the brahmins bathe their heads and dress in a new pair of linen robes. They make a heap of fresh cow dung and spread it with green grass. Then they make their beds between the boundary and the fire chamber.

verses.pali: Te taṁ rattiṁ tikkhattuṁ paccuṭṭhāya pañjalikā aggiṁ namassanti:
verses.english: That night they rise three times and worship the fire with cupped palms:
‘We descend, lord! We descend, lord!’
And they serve the fire with abundant ghee, oil, and butter.

verses.pali: Tassā ca rattiyā accayena paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena brāhmaṇe santappenti.
verses.english: And when the night has passed they serve the brahmins with delicious fresh and cooked foods.

verses.pali: Evaṁ, bho gotama, brāhmaṇānaṁ paccorohaṇī hotī”ti.
verses.english: That’s how the brahmins observe the ceremony of descent.”

verses.pali: “Aññathā kho, brāhmaṇa, brāhmaṇānaṁ paccorohaṇī hoti, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī”ti.
verses.english: “The ceremony of descent observed by the brahmins is quite different from that observed in the training of the Noble One.”

verses.pali: “Yathā kathaṁ pana, bho gotama, ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hoti?
verses.english: “But worthy Gotama, how is the ceremony of descent observed in the training of the Noble One?

verses.pali: Sādhu me bhavaṁ gotamo tathā dhammaṁ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī”ti.
verses.english: Worthy Gotama, please teach me this.”

verses.pali: “Tena hi, brāhmaṇa, suṇāhi, sādhukaṁ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
verses.english: “Well then, brahmin, listen and apply your mind well, I will speak.”

verses.pali: “Evaṁ, bho”ti kho jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo bhagavato paccassosi.
verses.english: “Yes, worthy sir,” Jānussoṇi replied.
The Buddha said this:
“It’s when a noble disciple reflects:
‘Wrong view has a bad result
in both this life and the next.’
Reflecting like this, they give up wrong view,
they descend from wrong view.
‘Wrong purpose has a bad result
in both this life and the next.’
Reflecting like this, they give up wrong purpose,
they descend from wrong purpose.
‘Wrong speech has a bad result
in both this life and the next.’
Reflecting like this, they give up wrong speech,
they descend from wrong speech.
‘Wrong action has a bad result
in both this life and the next.’
Reflecting like this, they give up wrong action,
they descend from wrong action.
‘Wrong livelihood has a bad result
in both this life and the next.’
Reflecting like this, they give up wrong livelihood,
they descend from wrong livelihood.
‘Wrong effort has a bad result
in both this life and the next.’
Reflecting like this, they give up wrong effort,
they descend from wrong effort.
‘Wrong mindfulness has a bad result
in both this life and the next.’
Reflecting like this, they give up wrong mindfulness,
they descend from wrong mindfulness.
‘Wrong immersion has a bad result
in both this life and the next.’
Reflecting like this, they give up wrong immersion,
they descend from wrong immersion.
‘Wrong knowledge has a bad result
in both this life and the next.’
Reflecting like this, they give up wrong knowledge,
they descend from wrong knowledge.
‘Wrong freedom has a bad result
in both this life and the next.’
Reflecting like this, they give up wrong freedom,
they descend from wrong freedom.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hotī”ti.
verses.english: This is the ceremony of descent in the training of the Noble One.”

verses.pali: “Aññathā, bho gotama, brāhmaṇānaṁ paccorohaṇī, aññathā ca pana ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇī hoti.
verses.english: “The ceremony of descent observed by the brahmins is quite different from that observed in the training of the Noble One.

verses.pali: Imissā ca, bho gotama, ariyassa vinaye paccorohaṇiyā brāhmaṇānaṁ paccorohaṇī kalaṁ nāgghati soḷasiṁ.
verses.english: And, worthy Gotama, the ceremony of descent observed by the brahmins is not worth a sixteenth part of a master of the ceremony of descent observed in the training of the Noble One.
Excellent, worthy Gotama! …

verses.pali: upāsakaṁ maṁ bhavaṁ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: From this day forth, may the worthy Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”
